verdict.rationale: Figma's MCP server explicitly supports writing to the canvas ('Create and modify native Figma content directly from your MCP client'), generating designs from live UI, and creating FigJam diagrams, in addition to reading design context — confirmed live via a runtime probe showing the hosted MCP endpoint at mcp.figma.com is operational. The Plugin API also explicitly supports read AND write access for programmatic design creation/modification, and the REST API includes write endpoints (variables CRUD, webhooks). missing for 10: independent hands-on third-party verification of actual write-mode MCP usage (only vendor docs and endpoint liveness probe, no community confirmation of write success).
